description: Standing re-measure list for wave land. Mode-3 green alone is not wave exit.

mode_1.measure: shots/<label>/capture.json source includes browser-threejs and excludes minimal-capture
shot-000.png mean luma > 4 and unique samples >= 8; dimensions >= 64x64
No Wooloo/TW plates under shots/wave* or shots/_sheets; contactsheet refuses minimal-capture
docs/VISUAL-BAR.md reviewed against still vs TW presentation (not claim of mode-7 win)

mode_3.measure: npm run test:playtest green — starter, grass, battle, catch, heal, no official name leak

mode_7_note: Blind A/B must prefer US over Twilight Wings reference; playtest green is not sufficient.
land_cmd: npm run typecheck && npm run test:battle && npm run test:playtest && npm run build && node tools/capture.mjs --label wave1
